The '''Taoist Party''' was the political movement associated with [[Xun Tao]] and the founding of the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]]. It led demonstrations against the declining [[Bu Dynasty]] in late 1934 and became the ideological core of the new people's federation founded in 1936.

This draft is a bridge page. The extracted Xanaqu source confirms the party's role but does not yet provide a full institutional history.

== Ideology ==

The party is associated with the [[Taoist Manifesto]], worker councils, proletarian democracy, social welfare, and a state structure built around the [[Central Workers Council|Central Workers' Council]].

Xanaqu's political culture emphasizes education, literacy, worker participation, public debate, and collective welfare. The Taoist Party appears to be the main party framework behind those institutions.

== Formation Role ==

The Taoist Party's anti-dynastic demonstrations helped bring down the Bu Dynasty. After republican rivals attempted to form a northern state, the party-aligned [[Red Army of Xanaqu|Red Army]] defeated them in the [[Xanaq Civil War]], clearing the way for the People's Federation.
